price.notes: Discovery-ceiling is the resource-server-declared upper bound; settled amount is read from the settlement receipt's amount field at execution time. The two are deliberately separate fields in the card per the v0 discriminator design.

authority.notes: Per-call human-principal approval. principal_id resolution depends on the inbound mandate; left null in the sample. Approval source is one of {human_principal, policy_engine, allowance, budget_rule, none, unknown} per the v0 tagged union.

cap.regulatory_basis: EMR 2011 reg 20-21 safeguarding obligations enforced at admission. AlgoVoi APM (Agent Payment Module) production platform safeguards prepaid GBP balances on agent mandates; caps are enforced server-side at the gateway pre-payment, not via cryptographic grant.
cap.notes: cap.enforcement = 'facilitator_policy' is the non-cryptographic discriminator of the v0 card. The Vauban Pay companion card (0001-vauban-bounded-spend.json) exercises the 'cryptographic' enforcement path with a grant_hash; this card exercises the regulatory-policy enforcement path with grant_hash = null. Both paths are first-class under the v0 card shape.

attestation_anchor.scheme: monotonic per-row SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON, off-VM Object-Lock COMPLIANCE retention
attestation_anchor.scheme_normative_source: draft-hopley-x402-canonicalisation-jcs-v1 (POSTED on IETF datatracker, sole AlgoVoi authorship)

charge_evidence.notes: charge_evidence.type = 'signed_attestation' is the v0 card discriminator for evidence retrieved via a signed attestation manifest (vs per-settlement 'receipt' which the Vauban companion card uses). Both shapes carry attestation_anchor: receipt-style anchor populates a per-tx SettlementReceipt hash; attestation-style anchor populates the manifest root, chain head, and retention deadline.

revocation.notes: Revocation surface is the AlgoVoi APM /compliance/screen endpoint. A buyer-agent preflight resolves the URL and reads the categorical decision (ALLOW / REFER / DENY) per draft-hopley-x402-compliance-receipt before constructing an x402 payment payload. Sanctions / KYC / KYB checks complete pre-payment; a REFER or DENY outcome blocks payment construction.

retention.scheme: Object Lock COMPLIANCE mode 7-year retention on off-VM storage; daily backup with 30-day rolling window
retention.regulatory_basis: MiCA Article 80, AMLR Article 56, DORA Article 14 record-keeping obligations

next_safe_threshold.requires: (a) authority.principal_id resolution against an inbound AP2 mandate (sample is null here because the card is a sample, not an active settlement); (b) price.status promotion to PASS by binding a settled_amount to the settlement-receipt hash for a specific transaction. Both fields move from PARTIAL to PASS in a live settlement.

preflight_verdict.reason: authority.status = PARTIAL (principal_id null in sample) and price.status = PARTIAL (no specific settlement amount bound). Per the v0 card discipline, all status fields must be PASS and all referenced URLs must resolve fresh before buyer_agent_can_spend_without_human can be true.
